name: XHAND 1 Pro-U
summary: A 16-DoF Robotera hand laid out to match NVIDIA GEAR Lab's DexUMI wearable exoskeleton joint for joint, so motion recorded on a human hand maps directly onto the robot. It is the hand in NVIDIA's GR00T 2 DexUMI demos, and orders opened in November 2026 for a first run of 40 units.

sources.title: Robotera Opens Orders for XHAND 1 Pro-U — Humanoids Daily
